displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.descriptionSupporter: As a VRC+ subscriber you can change your display name once every 30 days.
displayName.description: You can change your display name once every 90 days, or every 30 days with VRC+
displayName.revertNeedsPassword: Enter your current password to revert
displayName.enableRevertHint: Enter your password to enable revert

revertModal.title: Revert display name?
revertModal.body: This changes your display name back to <0>“{{name}}”</0> and <1>restarts the {{days}}-day timer</1> before you can change it again.

cooldown.heading: You can’t change your display name yet
cooldown.bodySupporter: You last changed it on <0>{{date}}</0> ({{ago}}). Your VRC+ plan allows one change every <1>{{days}} days</1>, so it unlocks on <2>{{unlockDate}}</2> (about {{left}} from now).
cooldown.body: You last changed it on <0>{{date}}</0> ({{ago}}). Your plan allows one change every <1>{{days}} days</1>, so it unlocks on <2>{{unlockDate}}</2> (about {{left}} from now).
cooldown.canRevert: You can still revert your last change using the button below.
cooldown.upsell: Subscribe to VRC+ to shorten this to 30 days.

email.title: Email
email.confirmSent: Check your inbox to confirm the new address.

password.title: Password
password.generatedDescription: This account signs in through a linked platform and has no password to change.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Protect your account with a time-based one-time code (TOTP) from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.storeSafely: Store these somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your authenticator.

disableModal.title: Disable two-factor authentication?
disableModal.body: Your account will be less secure without a second factor. You can re-enable it any time.

twoFactor.scanHint: Scan the QR with your authenticator, or enter this secret manually:

ageVerification.title: Age Verification
ageVerification.description: Verify your age to access age-restricted content and the 18+ badge. Requires a VRC+ subscription.

linkedAccounts.title: Linked Accounts
linkedAccounts.description: Linking is done on vrchat.com. This shows your current connections.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Control what connections others can see on your profile.
privacy.mutual: Show Mutual Friend and Group Connections
privacy.mutualHint: Lets others see friends and groups you have in common.
privacy.discordHint: Lets others see Discord friends you have in common.

contentGating.title: Content Gating
contentGating.description: Hide content you'd rather not see. These filters affect avatars and worlds across VRChat.
contentGating.locked: Filter settings are locked for this account.

userData.title: User Data
userData.description: Reset your saved user data in all worlds you've visited. To reset a specific world's data, visit that world's page.
userData.done: User data reset across all worlds.

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.description: Deleting your account is permanent. VRChat schedules deletion after a grace period.
dangerZone.scheduled: Account deletion is scheduled for <0>{{date}}</0>. Sign in on vrchat.com before then to cancel it.
